proof_body:
by
  intro R _ Y S hS n _ x₃
  exact CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₃ hS Y x₃ (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_projective _) (add_comm 1 n)
target_source: ∀ (R : Type) [Ring R] (Y : ModuleCat.{0} R) (S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{0} R)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ) [CategoryTheory.Projective S.X₂] (x₃ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₃ Y (n + 1)), ∃ x₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext S.X₁ Y n, hS.extClass.comp x₁ (add_comm 1 n) = x₃
